name: add_code_reference
description: Add a persistent reference to Cheat Engine's code-dissection data.

isString.description: For memory references, record the target as a string.

name: add_memory_record
description: Add a typed top-level memory record to the Cheat Engine address list.

address.description: Cheat Engine address expression, such as game.exe+10.

name: analyze_code_range
description: Run Cheat Engine's code dissector on one bounded target-memory range.

address.description: Range base address or symbol expression.

size.description: Range size in bytes (1-1048576).

name: aob_find
title: Find byte patterns
description: Find up to 8 array-of-bytes patterns (hex bytes and ?? wildcards) and report each pattern's matches, whether the count is exact and whether it is unique. Each pattern is one Cheat Engine scan that blocks Cheat Engine while it runs: without module or startAddress/endAddress it scans the whole target, so scope it, and use executable=required for code. Uniqueness needs limit 2 or more.

patterns.description: The patterns, 1 to 8, each up to 4096 byte positions, such as 48 8B ?? ?? ?? ?? 89 43 10.

module.description: Scan only this loaded module's image, such as game.exe; faster and cannot match in another module.

startAddress.description: The first allowed match address or expression; requires endAddress.

endAddress.description: The last allowed match address or expression; requires startAddress.

writable.description: Whether matches must be in writable memory: required, excluded or any (default).

executable.description: Whether matches must be in executable memory: required, excluded or any (default).

copyOnWrite.description: Whether matches must be in copy-on-write memory: required, excluded or any (default).

alignment.description: Only match addresses divisible by this number, such as 4; not with lastDigits.

lastDigits.description: Only match addresses whose hexadecimal form ends with these 1 to 16 digits; not with alignment.

limit.description: The most matches to list per pattern, 1 to 10000.

results.description: One entry per requested pattern, in request order.

pattern.description: The pattern as scanned: uppercase byte pairs and ?? wildcards separated by single spaces.

exact.description: Whether count is proven to be every match in scope; false when the limit cut the list or Cheat Engine cannot tell zero matches from a failure.

unique.description: Whether exactly one match exists in scope: exact and count 1. Use a limit of at least 2.

scope.description: What Cheat Engine scanned: bounded_scan (only the module or range), global_scan, filtered_global_scan (whole target, then filtered) or unknown.

targetVerified.description: Whether the matches belong to one confirmed target incarnation for the whole scan.

elapsedMs.description: How long Cheat Engine's scan and the copy of its result took, in milliseconds.

matches.description: The match addresses in Cheat Engine's order, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

name: aob_generate_signature
title: Generate an AOB signature
description: Generate an array-of-bytes signature that finds an address inside a loaded module (Cheat Engine's getUniqueAOB), then verify it with a separate scan of that module. The address must be inside a module of at most 64 MiB; others are refused because Cheat Engine would scan the whole address space. Blocks Cheat Engine while it scans; review the pattern and mask displacements before relying on it.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression inside a loaded module, such as game.exe+1C0.

module.description: The module that must contain the address; defaults to the module that contains it.

verify.description: Whether to verify the signature with a separate bounded scan of the module.

address.description: The resolved address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

module.description: The module that contains the address and was scanned.

unique.description: Whether the signature matches only once in the module: proven by the verification scan when verified is true.

verified.description: Whether a separate bounded scan of the module checked the signature.

pattern.description: The signature, uppercase byte pairs and ?? wildcards; omitted when Cheat Engine found no unique signature.

patternStart.description: Where a match of the signature begins, uppercase hexadecimal: the address minus offset.

offset.description: The distance in bytes from patternStart to the address; inject at match+offset.

matchCount.description: How many matches the verification scan found; 2 means at least 2. Omitted when not verified.

triedPattern.description: Cheat Engine's last attempt when it found no unique signature, when it reported one.

name: assemble
description: Assemble one target instruction into bytes through the Client instruction capability.

instruction.description: Assembly source for exactly one instruction.

address.description: Target origin as hexadecimal; required for relative operands.

name: auto_assemble

script.description: Complete Auto Assembler source, required when applying a patch.

disableId.description: Patch ID returned by a prior enable call. Supplying it releases that Client-owned patch.

name.description: Optional diagnostic name for a new patch.

name: auto_assemble_check
description: Check an Auto Assembler [ENABLE] section without applying a patch.

name.description: Optional diagnostic name for the script.

name: clear_code_analysis
description: Clear Cheat Engine's current code-dissection data and references.

name: convert_string
description: Convert text with a managed MD5 digest or explicit UTF-8 and ANSI byte round trips.

name: create_process
description: Launch and open a process through Cheat Engine. This starts an external executable.

breakOnEntryPoint.description: Break at entry point; requires debug=true.

name: dbk_control_registers
description: Read copied CR0, CR3, and CR4 values through DBK.

name: dbk_physical_address
description: Resolve a target virtual address to its physical address through DBK.

address.description: Target virtual address expression or number.

name: dbk_status
description: Report whether DBK is already initialized; this query does not initialize it.

name: dbvm_cr4
description: Read DBVM's real CR4 value.

name: dbvm_initialize
description: Initialize DBVM. Offloading the operating system is advanced and can destabilize the host.

offloadOperatingSystem.description: Offload the operating system when possible.

reason.description: Short diagnostic reason, up to 256 characters.

name: dbvm_read_physical
description: Read a bounded physical-memory range through DBVM.

address.description: Physical address expression or number.

size.description: Byte count from 1 through 4096.

name: dbvm_status
description: Report whether DBVM is already initialized; this query does not initialize it.

name: dbvm_watch
description: Capture a DBVM watch for up to five seconds and disable it before returning up to 1024 copied events.

address.description: Physical address expression or number.

options.description: DBVM options bit field, bits 0-3 only.

durationMilliseconds.description: Capture duration (1-5000 milliseconds). Blocks Cheat Engine during capture.

name: dbvm_watch_log
description: Retrieve a bounded copied DBVM watch log.

name: dbvm_watch_stop
description: Disable a DBVM watch by identifier.

name: dbvm_write_physical
description: Write a bounded hexadecimal byte sequence to physical memory through DBVM.

address.description: Physical address expression or number.

name: debugger_add_breakpoint
description: Create an execute, access, or write breakpoint. It persists until removed or debugger detachment.

address.description: Target address expression or number.

size.description: Watch size for access or write: 1, 2, 4, or 8.

name: debugger_break_thread
description: Request that Cheat Engine break a target thread; stopping can be asynchronous.

name: debugger_breakpoints
description: Return a bounded copied list of breakpoint addresses.

name: debugger_context
description: Read copied current registers; the debugger must be broken for meaningful values.

name: debugger_continue
description: Continue, step into, or step over from the current broken context.

name: debugger_detach
description: Unpause and detach the debugger while preserving the current target selection.

name: debugger_ignore_thread
description: Add or remove a target thread from Cheat Engine's breakpoint-ignore list.

name: debugger_poll_capture
description: Read buffered breakpoint hits in FIFO order without waiting; clear removes only the returned hits.

clear.description: Remove the returned hits from the buffer.

name: debugger_poll_step_trace
description: Copy collected trace contexts without waiting or consuming them.

name: debugger_remove_breakpoint
description: Remove the breakpoint containing the supplied address.

address.description: Breakpoint address expression or number.

name: debugger_set_register
description: Set one general-purpose register in the currently broken debugger context, then write the context back before continuation.

register.description: Register name: EAX through EIP, RAX through R15, RIP, RSP, RBP, or EFLAGS.

name: debugger_start
description: Attach the selected debugger interface. A repeated request is idempotent. Interface changes require explicit detach; targets previously using VEH must restart before reattachment.

name: debugger_start_capture
description: Find instructions accessing or writing an address using a pollable breakpoint capture. Hits contain trap IP, thread ID and registers. Automatically expires; poll results within 30 seconds of expiry.

address.description: Target address expression or number.

size.description: Aligned data-watch size: 1, 2, 4, or 8.

maximumHits.description: Maximum buffered hits, 1-1024; excess hits are counted as dropped.

name: debugger_start_step_trace
description: Break at an address and single-step one thread for a bounded number of contexts, then leave it stopped. Requires no existing breakpoints or global breakpoint hook. Results expire 30 seconds after completion or timeout.

address.description: Entry instruction address expression.

maximumSteps.description: Maximum contexts including the entry instruction, 1-256.

name: debugger_status
description: Read copied debugger state and active interface.

name: debugger_stop_capture
description: Remove the owned capture breakpoint, timer, and results. Cleanup failures retain the ID for retry.

name: debugger_stop_step_trace
description: Remove the owned trace breakpoint, hook, timer and results. Does not resume a stopped thread; cleanup failures retain the ID for retry.

name: delete_code_reference
description: Remove one source-to-destination code reference.

name: delete_memory_record
description: Delete one memory record by Client-issued record ID.

name: disassemble
description: Disassemble one instruction or obtain its exact length at a target address.

address.description: Target address as hexadecimal.

name: disassemble_bytes
description: Disassemble a bounded hexadecimal byte sequence without reading target memory.

hexadecimalBytes.description: Hexadecimal bytes, up to 1 MiB of text.

address.description: Optional target origin expression for relative operands.

name: disassemble_range
description: Disassemble a bounded sequence of target instructions using the Client's typed assembly API.

address.description: Start address or symbol expression.
