name: execute_lua
description: Execute trusted Lua through the Client capability, enabled by default. Prefer typed MCP tools whenever possible.

chunkName.description: Optional non-empty chunk name for Lua diagnostics.

name: execute_remote_code
description: Execute a one-parameter stdcall function in the selected target and return its copied result.

address.description: Target function address expression or number.

timeoutMilliseconds.description: Timeout in milliseconds, 1 through 300000. The call waits for completion within the supplied timeout.

name: find_memory_records_by_description
description: Find up to 1024 current address-list records matching an exact description.

description.description: Exact record description, up to 256 characters.

name: generate_api_hook_script
description: Generate a Cheat Engine Auto Assembler API-hook script without applying it.

address.description: Hook address expression.

newCallAddress.description: Optional symbol for the new call address.

name: get_address_list
description: Copy the current top-level Cheat Engine address list.

maximumRecords.description: Maximum records to materialize. The request fails if the table exceeds this bound.

name: get_code_references
description: Read copied references to an address from Cheat Engine's current code dissector data.

address.description: Target address or symbol expression.

name: get_comment
description: Read the persistent user-defined Memory View comment at a target address.

address.description: Target address or symbol expression.

name: get_current_process
description: Get the process currently selected in Cheat Engine.

name: get_function_range
description: Return Cheat Engine's estimated function boundaries for a target address.

address.description: Address inside the target function.

name: get_memory_record_details
description: Read pointer offsets and script text for one current Cheat Engine memory-record ID.

name: get_memory_scan_results
description: Read a bounded page from main's visible CE found list, including manual scans, or an independent Client session. Main must have completed; unknown-initial baselines need a next scan first.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or an existing independent scanner name.

name: get_memory_scan_status
description: Get main's live UI scan state or an independent session's state. Poll main until ResultsReady or BaselineReady before reading or narrowing; Scanning is still in progress.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or an existing independent scanner name.

name: get_opened_file_size
description: Get the size of the currently opened file-as-process target.

name: get_plugin_version
description: Get the loaded plugin version and assembly path.

name: get_pointer_size
description: Get Cheat Engine's configured target pointer size.

name: get_previous_opcodes
description: Return a bounded predecessor-instruction walk before one target address.

address.description: Target address or symbol expression.

name: get_process_list
description: List a bounded set of local processes.

name: get_process_state
description: Get the currently opened target process ID, pause state, and age.

name: get_referenced_functions
description: List bounded function addresses referenced by the current code dissector data.

name: get_referenced_strings
description: Read a bounded copied list of strings referenced by current code dissector data.

name: get_runtime_info
description: Read the active Client epoch, host version and capability evidence before using optional features.

name: get_selected_memory_record
description: Read the currently selected Cheat Engine address-list record with pointer-offset details.

name: get_speedhack_speed
description: Get Cheat Engine's last configured speedhack speed.

name: get_thread_list
description: List target thread IDs reported by Cheat Engine, capped at 4096 entries.

name: inject_dotnet_library
description: Inject a managed assembly and invoke its static entry point in the selected target.

name: inject_library
description: Inject a native DLL or library into the selected target. Cheat Engine must report true for success.

fileName.description: Absolute library path, up to 32767 characters.

skipSymbolReloadWait.description: Skip symbol reload wait after injection.

name: is_jump_destination
description: Check whether an address is a jump destination within a bounded code range.

address.description: Address to test.

range.description: Containing function or code-range size in bytes (1-1048576).

name: list_memory_scanners
description: List main (the currently visible CE scan tab) and up to 32 independent Client scan sessions in this instance. Independent scanner names do not refer to CE UI tabs.

name: load_cheat_table
description: Load a trusted absolute Cheat Engine table path. The Client enforces configured table roots.

filename.description: Absolute .CT or .CETRAINER path under a configured trusted table root.

merge.description: Merge into the current table instead of replacing it.

name: memory_allocate
title: Allocate memory
description: Allocate target memory under a caller-chosen name, read and write by default or executable for code (up to 16 MiB each, 128 allocations and 64 MiB per activation). The allocation is an activation resource: free it with memory_free or runtime_release_resources before switching processes; disabling the plugin frees it too.

name.description: A unique name for the allocation, 1 to 256 characters; memory_free takes it back.

size.description: The number of bytes to allocate, 1 to 16777216; Cheat Engine may round it up to a page.

executable.description: Whether the memory is executable (read, write and execute), for injected code.

near.description: An address or expression near which Cheat Engine should allocate, for code that jumps with a 32-bit displacement; Cheat Engine may allocate elsewhere.

name.description: The caller's name for the allocation; pass it to memory_free.

address.description: The allocated address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The requested size in bytes; Cheat Engine may round the allocation up to a page.

executable.description: Whether the memory is executable (read, write and execute) rather than read and write.

resourceId.description: The id under which runtime_list_resources lists the allocation.

name: memory_compare
title: Compare memory
description: Compare two target ranges of up to 16 MiB and list the differing runs with both byte sequences. Reads 1 MiB per Cheat Engine dispatch and fails with target_changed if Cheat Engine selects another process in between; stops once maxDifferences runs are listed.

addressA.description: The first address or Cheat Engine address expression.

addressB.description: The second address or Cheat Engine address expression.

size.description: The number of bytes to compare, 1 to 16777216.

maxDifferences.description: The most differing runs to list, 1 to 256.

addressA.description: The resolved first address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

addressB.description: The resolved second address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The number of bytes compared.

equal.description: Whether the two ranges hold the same bytes.

truncated.description: Whether more differences exist than maxDifferences listed; comparing stopped there.

differences.description: The differing runs, in offset order; a run longer than 64 bytes continues in the next entry.

offset.description: The run's offset from both addresses, hexadecimal.

length.description: The run's length in bytes, at most 64.

a.description: The bytes of the run at addressA, spaced hexadecimal.

b.description: The bytes of the run at addressB, spaced hexadecimal.

name: memory_copy
title: Copy memory
description: Copy up to 1 MiB from one target address to another: the whole source is read first, so overlapping ranges copy correctly. The destination is overwritten; allocate it with memory_allocate when it must be new memory.

source.description: The source address or Cheat Engine address expression.

destination.description: The destination address or Cheat Engine address expression.

size.description: The number of bytes to copy, 1 to 1048576.

source.description: The resolved source address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

destination.description: The resolved destination address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The number of bytes copied.

name: memory_dump_to_file
title: Dump memory to a file
description: Write up to 256 MiB of target memory to a file on the Cheat Engine host. The path must be absolute, local and inside a folder listed in Mcp:Files:AllowedRoots (empty by default, which refuses every dump); the MCP data and registry folders are always refused. Reads 1 MiB per dispatch into a temporary file that replaces the target file only when complete; unreadable memory fails the dump unless unreadable is zero.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression.

size.description: The number of bytes to dump, 1 to 268435456.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to write, inside a folder of Mcp:Files:AllowedRoots.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing file may be replaced.

unreadable.description: What to do with unreadable memory: fail (default, no file is written) or zero (write zeros and list them).

path.description: The normalized full path of the written file.

address.description: The resolved address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

bytesWritten.description: The file's length in bytes: the requested size.

zeroFilledBytes.description: How many bytes were unreadable and written as zeros.

zeroFilled.description: The zero-filled ranges, in offset order, at most 256.

offset.description: The range's offset in the file and from the address, hexadecimal.

truncated.description: Whether more zero-filled ranges exist than listed.

name: memory_free
title: Free memory
description: Free a named allocation made by memory_allocate. An unknown name is not_found. A release that did not complete fails with partial_effect: retryable when nothing was done yet (the name stays and memory_free can be repeated), otherwise the memory may remain in the target and needs manual recovery.

name.description: The allocation name given to memory_allocate.

address.description: The allocation's address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The allocation's size in bytes.

release.description: What the release did; only a complete release frees the name.

hostEffect.description: How far the Cheat Engine release work got.

isRetryable.description: Whether nothing was done yet, so a later release tries again.

requiresManualRecovery.description: Whether something may remain that only manual recovery can remove.

name: memory_get_address_info
title: Describe addresses
description: Describe up to 256 addresses: Cheat Engine's symbol name, the containing module and section, whether it is a system module, the memory region (state, protection, backing) and optionally the pointer-sized value stored there and the RTTI class name of the object there. An address that does not resolve reports its own error in band.

addresses.description: The addresses or Cheat Engine address expressions to describe, 1 to 256.

includeRtti.description: Whether to look up the RTTI class name of the object at each address (MSVC C++ objects with a vtable).

includePointerValue.description: Whether to read the pointer-sized value stored at each address.

items.description: One entry per requested address, in request order; check each error.

address.description: The resolved address in uppercase hexadecimal, or the request text when it did not resolve.

symbol.description: Cheat Engine's name for the address, such as game.exe+1C0 or a symbol.

module.description: The loaded module that contains the address, when there is one.

section.description: The module section that contains the address, such as .text, when known.

isSystemModule.description: Whether Cheat Engine counts the address as inside a system module.

region.description: The memory region that contains the address, when Cheat Engine reports one.

base.description: The region's base address, uppercase hexadecimal.

size.description: The region's size in bytes.

state.description: The region's state: committed, reserved, free or unknown.

read.description: Whether the pages can be read.

write.description: Whether the pages can be written, copy-on-write included.

execute.description: Whether the pages can be executed.

copyOnWrite.description: Whether a write gives the process a private copy of the page.

type.description: The region's backing: image, mapped, private, none or unknown.

allocationBase.description: The base of the allocation the region belongs to, uppercase hexadecimal.

pointerValue.description: The pointer-sized value stored at the address, when includePointerValue was set and it is readable.

rttiClass.description: The RTTI class name of the object at the address, when includeRtti was set and Cheat Engine finds one.

error.description: Why this address was not described; the other items are unaffected.

kind.description: The failure class, such as memory_read_failed or not_found.

name: memory_hash
title: Hash memory
description: Hash a target range of up to 64 MiB with MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256, for example to detect that code or data changed. Reads 1 MiB per Cheat Engine dispatch and fails with target_changed if Cheat Engine selects another process in between; an unreadable byte fails with memory_read_failed.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression.

size.description: The number of bytes to hash, 1 to 67108864.

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm: md5, sha1 or sha256.

address.description: The resolved address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The number of bytes hashed.

hash.description: The digest as lowercase hexadecimal without separators.

name: memory_list_regions
title: List memory regions
description: List the target's memory regions in address order, one page at a time, filtered by address range, module, state (committed by default), backing and the writable, executable and copy-on-write flags. The detailed format adds the allocation base, allocation protection and mapped file.

startAddress.description: Keep only regions that end after this address or expression; use with endAddress or alone.

endAddress.description: Keep only regions that start at or before this address or expression.

module.description: Keep only regions inside this loaded module's image, such as game.exe.

state.description: The region state to keep: committed (default), reserved, free or any.

writable.description: Whether regions must be writable: required, excluded or any (default).

executable.description: Whether regions must be executable: required, excluded or any (default).

copyOnWrite.description: Whether regions must be copy-on-write: required, excluded or any (default).

type.description: The backing to keep: image, mapped, private or any (default).

offset.description: The zero-based index of the first region to return.

limit.description: The most regions to return, 1 to 2000.

format.description: concise (default) or detailed, which adds allocation base, allocation protection and mapped file.

total.description: How many regions match the filters.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted when this page ends the listing.

truncated.description: Whether a host-side cap shortened the region map itself.

regions.description: The regions of this page, in address order.

base.description: The region's base address, uppercase hexadecimal.

size.description: The region's size in bytes.

state.description: The region's state: committed, reserved, free or unknown.

read.description: Whether the pages can be read.

write.description: Whether the pages can be written, copy-on-write included.

execute.description: Whether the pages can be executed.

copyOnWrite.description: Whether a write gives the process a private copy of the page.

type.description: The region's backing: image, mapped, private, none or unknown.

module.description: The loaded module whose image contains the region, when there is one.

allocationBase.description: The base of the allocation the region belongs to; detailed format only.

allocationProtection.description: The access the allocation was created with; detailed format only.

read.description: Whether the pages can be read.

write.description: Whether the pages can be written, copy-on-write included.

execute.description: Whether the pages can be executed.

copyOnWrite.description: Whether a write gives the process a private copy of the page.

mappedFile.description: Cheat Engine's description of the mapped file, when it reports one; detailed format only.

name: memory_read
title: Read memory
description: Read target memory at one address: one typed value, up to 1024 consecutive values of a fixed-size type (count), a string (length) or raw bytes (size). Values are text: decimal integers, round-trippable floats, hexadecimal pointers, spaced hexadecimal bytes. An unreadable address fails with memory_read_failed.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression, such as game.exe+1C, [game.exe+10]+8 or 7FF6A1B2C3D0.

count.description: How many consecutive values of a fixed-size type to read, 1 to 1024; only 1 for string, wstring and bytes.

size.description: The byte count for valueType bytes, 1 to 16384; refused for other types.

length.description: The maximum string length for string and wstring, 1 to 4096 (default 256); refused for other types.

address.description: The resolved address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

valueType.description: The value type that was read.

value.description: The value as text when count is 1: decimal integers, round-trippable floats, a hexadecimal pointer, the text of a string or spaced hexadecimal bytes.

values.description: The consecutive values in address order when count is above 1.

name: memory_read_batch
title: Read many addresses
description: Read up to 1024 addresses, each with its own value type, in one call (256 KiB in total). Fixed-size types are read in typed batches; an address that does not resolve or cannot be read reports its own error in band while the others are still read, so check every item.

items.description: The addresses to read, 1 to 1024, each with its value type and, for bytes or strings, its size or length.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression, such as game.exe+1C or 7FF6A1B2C3D0.

size.description: The byte count, 1 to 16384; required for bytes and refused for other types.

length.description: The maximum string length, 1 to 4096 (default 256); only for string and wstring.

failed.description: How many items carry an error instead of a value; check every item.

items.description: One entry per request item, in request order.

address.description: The resolved address in uppercase hexadecimal, or the request text when it did not resolve.

value.description: The value as text, when it was read.

error.description: Why this item was not read; the other items are unaffected.

kind.description: The failure class, such as memory_read_failed or not_found.

name: memory_scan
description: Start a value scan. The default main scanner uses CE's visible scan tab and UI options; poll its status for completion. Other names create independent Client sessions without changing the UI. Reset explicitly before another first scan.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or a unique case-sensitive name for an independent session (up to 32). The name main is reserved.

valueType.description: byte, int16, int32 (default), int64, float, double, string, wstring, or bytes.

value.description: Value for exact, between, greater, or less comparisons; omit for unknown initial value.

comparison.description: exact, unknown, between, greater, or less.

upperValue.description: Inclusive upper value for a between comparison.

name: memory_set_protection
title: Set memory protection
description: Change the page protection of up to 16 MiB of target memory (Cheat Engine's setMemoryProtection, or fullAccess when read, write and execute are all set). The entire range must fit in one committed memory region, so its returned previous access can restore the range. Change protection only with consent and restore previous when done.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression.

size.description: The number of bytes whose pages change, 1 to 16777216; all must fit in one committed memory region.

read.description: Whether the pages can be read.

write.description: Whether the pages can be written.

execute.description: Whether the pages can be executed.

address.description: The resolved address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The size of the changed range in bytes.

previous.description: The access of every page before the change; restore the whole range with this tool using it.

read.description: Whether the page can be read.

write.description: Whether the page can be written.

execute.description: Whether the page can be executed.

current.description: The access of the first page after the change; compare it with the request, as some systems refuse write and execute together.

read.description: Whether the page can be read.

write.description: Whether the page can be written.

execute.description: Whether the page can be executed.

name: memory_write
title: Write memory
description: Write one typed value, a string or bytes to target memory. The first 64 bytes of the range are read first and returned as previous, so the write can be undone with valueType bytes; with verify the written bytes are read back. A wrong write can crash the target: write only addresses you identified, one at a time.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression, such as game.exe+1C or 7FF6A1B2C3D0.

value.description: The value as text: decimal or 0x hexadecimal integers, invariant floats (NaN, Infinity), a hexadecimal pointer, the text of a string or spaced hexadecimal bytes such as 90 90.

repeat.description: How many times to write the bytes back to back, 1 to 65536 (1 MiB in total); only for bytes.

nullTerminate.description: Whether to append a terminating zero character; only for string and wstring.

verify.description: Whether to read the range back and compare it with the written bytes.

address.description: The resolved address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

previous.description: The first bytes the range held before the write, at most 64, as spaced hexadecimal; write them back with valueType bytes to undo.

verified.description: Whether a read-back matched every written byte; false when verify was off or another writer changed the range.

name: memory_write_batch
title: Write many addresses
description: Write up to 1024 addresses in request order, each with its own value type (1 MiB in total). Every address is resolved before the first write. The writes are not atomic: a failure stops the batch and reports partial_effect with completed, failedIndex and effectState, and the completed items stay written.

items.description: The writes, 1 to 1024, each with its address, value type and value.

address.description: An address or Cheat Engine address expression, such as game.exe+1C or 7FF6A1B2C3D0.

value.description: The value as text: decimal or 0x hexadecimal integers, invariant floats, a hexadecimal pointer, the text of a string or spaced hexadecimal bytes.

verify.description: Whether to read every item back after the batch and list the items that differ.

written.description: How many items were written, all of them on success.

verified.description: Whether a read-back matched every item; false when verify was off or an item differs.

mismatched.description: The indices of the items whose read-back differs from the written bytes.

name: module_find_patches
title: Find module patches
description: Compare one module's executable sections in memory with its file on disk, after applying the file's base relocations, and report each differing range with its address, Cheat Engine name, file bytes and memory bytes: hooks, code patches and MCP or Cheat Engine injections. Read-only, in 256 KiB chunks; at most 64 MiB per call. The module's file must be on a local fixed drive (UNC, device and linked paths are refused) and must be the build that was loaded. The import address table is skipped; includeNonExecutable also compares data sections, which a running program changes on its own.

module.description: The module name, such as game.exe, or an address expression inside it.

includeNonExecutable.description: Also compare non-executable sections; they change at run time, so expect many differences.

limit.description: The most differing ranges to report, 1 to 1024.

filePath.description: The module file that was compared.

unreadableBytes.description: How many bytes of the module's memory could not be read and were skipped.

relocationsApplied.description: How many base relocations were applied to the file bytes before comparing.

truncated.description: Whether the scan stopped at limit patches or at the 64 MiB comparison cap.

address.description: The first differing address as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

section.description: The section that holds the range, such as .text.

length.description: The length of the range in bytes; runs closer than four bytes are merged.

fileBytes.description: The file's bytes after relocation, at most the first 64.

memoryBytes.description: The bytes in memory, at most the first 64.

symbol.description: Cheat Engine's name for the address, such as game.exe+1A2B; omitted when it has none.

name: module_get
title: Get module details
description: Read one module of the attached process: base, size, file path, its sections (with executable and writable flags) and the fields of its mapped PE header: machine, COFF time stamp, entry point, subsystem, DLL and .NET flags and the PDB it names. The time stamp identifies the build, so keep it to tell later whether the game was updated. module is a name such as game.exe (case-insensitive) or any address expression inside the module.

module.description: The module name, such as game.exe, or an address expression inside it, such as game.exe+1000.

base.description: The base address as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

path.description: The module's file on disk, as Cheat Engine reports it.

sections.description: The module's sections, as Cheat Engine enumerates them.

address.description: The section address as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The section size in bytes.

fileOffset.description: The section's offset in the module file, as uppercase hexadecimal.

executable.description: Whether the PE header marks the section as code or executable; omitted when unknown.

writable.description: Whether the PE header marks the section writable; omitted when unknown.

size.description: The mapped size in bytes, when Cheat Engine reports it.

pe.description: The PE header fields; omitted when the mapped header cannot be read or parsed.

machine.description: The CPU the image targets: x86, x64, arm, arm64 or unknown.

timeDateStamp.description: The raw COFF time stamp as uppercase hexadecimal; it identifies a build, and reproducible builds store a hash in it.

headerImageBase.description: The ImageBase field of the mapped header; Windows usually rewrites it to the load address, so it is not the file's preferred base.

subsystem.description: The subsystem, such as windows_gui or windows_cui.

isDll.description: Whether the image is a DLL.

managed.description: Whether the image has a CLR header, which marks a .NET assembly.

timeDateStampUtc.description: The time stamp read as seconds since 1970 in UTC; omitted when it is zero.

entryPoint.description: The entry point address as uppercase hexadecimal; omitted when the image has none.

pdb.description: The PDB the image names in its CodeView record; omitted when it names none.

path.description: The PDB path recorded at link time.

signature.description: The PDB signature GUID, uppercase with dashes.

age.description: The PDB age; a symbol server keys the PDB by GUID and age.

name: module_list
title: List modules
description: Page the modules (EXE and DLLs) loaded in the attached process, or in another process by processId, in Cheat Engine's order. concise returns name, base and size; detailed adds is64Bit and the file path. Filter with nameContains, then page with offset and limit (at most 1000). Use it to classify the runtime (mono, GameAssembly, coreclr) and to find a module for module_get.

processId.description: Another process's id; omit it for the attached process.

nameContains.description: A case-insensitive substring of the module name, such as mono or .dll; at most 256 characters.

offset.description: The index of the first module to return.

limit.description: The most modules to return, 1 to 1000.

format.description: concise (name, base, size) or detailed (adds is64Bit and path).

processId.description: The process whose modules are listed.

total.description: The number of modules that match nameContains.

modules.description: The modules of this page, in Cheat Engine's order.

name.description: The module name, such as game.exe.

base.description: The base address as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The mapped size in bytes, when Cheat Engine reports it.

is64Bit.description: Whether the module is 64-bit; only with format detailed.

path.description: The module's file on disk; only with format detailed.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted on the last page.

name: module_list_exports
title: List module exports
description: Page the exports of one module of the attached process, parsed from its export directory in memory: name (omitted for ordinal-only exports), ordinal and address, or the forwarder such as NTDLL.RtlAllocateHeap for a forwarded export. Filter with nameContains, then page with offset and limit (at most 1000). A module whose export data exceeds 8 MiB or 65536 entries is refused.

module.description: The module name, such as kernel32.dll, or an address expression inside it.

nameContains.description: A case-insensitive substring of the export name; at most 256 characters.

offset.description: The index of the first export to return.

limit.description: The most exports to return, 1 to 1000.

total.description: The number of exports that match nameContains.

exports.description: The exports of this page, by ordinal.

name.description: The export name; omitted for an ordinal-only export.

address.description: The function address as uppercase hexadecimal; omitted for a forwarder.

forwarder.description: The forwarder, such as NTDLL.RtlAllocateHeap, when the export forwards to another module.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted on the last page.

name: next_memory_scan
description: Narrow main's visible CE scan (including a manually started scan), or a named independent Client scan. Poll main's status until completion.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or an existing independent scanner name.

value.description: Value for exact, between, greater, less, increasedBy, or decreasedBy comparisons; omit for state comparisons.

comparison.description: exact, between, greater, less, increased, decreased, increasedBy, decreasedBy, changed, or unchanged.

upperValue.description: Inclusive upper value for a between comparison.

name: open_file_as_process
description: Open a file through Cheat Engine's process-like memory interface.

startAddress.description: Optional base address expression or number.

name: open_process
description: Attach Cheat Engine to a process ID or exact process name.

process.description: A positive process ID or an exact process name.

name: pause_process
description: Pause the currently opened Cheat Engine target process.

name: pointer_create_map
title: Create a pointer map
description: Starts a job that captures a pointer map: every aligned pointer-sized value that points into committed memory, read in short dispatches that recheck the selected process. Poll pointer_list_maps until state is ready; a changed process discards the map (target_changed). Stop it with pointer_delete_map or runtime_stop_job(jobId): a stopped map keeps what it read. The job ends at its TTL or a plugin disable; the map lives in this activation's memory until deleted, at most 4 maps and 8388608 pointers.

mapName.description: The new map's name, 1 to 128 characters.

startAddress.description: The first address to capture, an address or expression; requires endAddress.

endAddress.description: The last address to capture, inclusive; requires startAddress.

writableOnly.description: Capture only writable memory, where static pointers live.

alignment.description: The alignment of captured pointers: 1, 2, 4 or 8. 4 also finds 4-aligned pointers on x64.

maxBytes.description: The most bytes read, 1 to 536870912 (512 MiB).

lifetimeSeconds.description: The job's TTL in seconds, 1 to 300; 120 by default. The map outlives its job.

jobId.description: The capture job's id, for runtime_list_jobs and runtime_stop_job.

state.description: Where the capture stands; the map is usable when ready, stopped or expired.

processId.description: The process the map was captured from.

pointerSize.description: The target pointer width in bytes, 4 or 8.

unreadableBytes.description: How many requested bytes could not be read.

incomplete.description: Whether the capture skipped memory or stopped early; absence in the map is then no proof.

progressPercent.description: How much of the planned memory was read, 0 to 100.

error.description: Why the capture failed or ended early.

name: pointer_delete_map
title: Delete a pointer map
description: Deletes a pointer map and frees its memory, stopping its capture job first when it still runs. Scans already found from the map keep their paths. An unknown name fails with not_found.

name.description: The deleted map or scan name.

cancelledJob.description: Whether its job was still running and was stopped.

name: pointer_delete_scan
title: Delete a pointer scan
description: Deletes a pointer scan and frees its paths, stopping its search job first when it still runs. An unknown name fails with not_found.

name.description: The deleted map or scan name.

cancelledJob.description: Whether its job was still running and was stopped.

name: pointer_find_paths
title: Find pointer paths
description: Starts a job that searches a stored pointer map for paths from static roots to target, off Cheat Engine's main thread; a symbolic target costs one dispatch to resolve. Poll pointer_list_scans until state is ready, then page the paths with pointer_list_paths. Stop it with pointer_delete_scan or runtime_stop_job(jobId): a stopped search keeps the paths found so far. The job ends at its TTL or a plugin disable. Negative offsets and larger limits multiply the work; incomplete or traversalLimited with no path is no proof that none exists.

scanName.description: The new scan's name, 1 to 128 characters.

mapName.description: The pointer map to search; see pointer_list_maps.

target.description: The address the paths must reach: hexadecimal, or a symbol resolved in the selected process.

maxDepth.description: The most dereferences in a path, 1 to 8.

maxOffset.description: The largest offset after a dereference, 0 to 1048576 bytes.

allowNegativeOffsets.description: Also follow pointers that point past the address they lead to (negative offsets).

staticRootsOnly.description: Keep only paths whose root lies in a module image, so they survive a restart.

maxNodes.description: The most candidate pointers visited, 1 to 10000000.

lifetimeSeconds.description: The job's TTL in seconds, 1 to 300; 120 by default. The paths outlive the job.

jobId.description: The search job's id, for runtime_list_jobs and runtime_stop_job.

state.description: Where the search stands; the paths are usable when ready, stopped or expired.

incomplete.description: Whether the paths may miss some: an incomplete map, a limit, a stop or unresolved paths.

traversalLimited.description: Whether maxNodes or maxResults stopped the search.

visitedNodes.description: How many candidate pointers were visited.

elapsedMs.description: How long the search ran, in milliseconds.

error.description: Why the search failed or ended early.

name: pointer_find_references
title: Find pointer references
description: Finds the addresses that hold a pointer to target, or to at most maxOffset bytes below it: the holders of an object, one level of a hand-built chain. With mapName it searches that stored map, nearest first, without scanning. Otherwise it scans live memory once, blocking Cheat Engine while the scan runs: an exact 4-aligned AOB scan for maxOffset 0, else a temporary value scan released before the call returns. A symbol marks a holder inside a module image, a static root.

target.description: The address the pointers lead to: an address, symbol or expression.

maxOffset.description: The largest distance below target a pointer may point, 0 to 65536; 0 finds exact pointers.

mapName.description: A stored pointer map to search instead of live memory.

module.description: Only holders inside this module image, such as game.exe.

writableOnly.description: Live search only: keep holders in writable memory, where static pointers live.

source.description: Where the search looked: map or live.

count.description: How many holders match, including those beyond the limit.

truncated.description: Whether more holders match than were returned.

references.description: The holders returned; a map search lists the nearest first.

address.description: The address that holds the pointer, uppercase hexadecimal.

offset.description: The target minus the pointer value, signed hexadecimal: the offset to add after reading.

symbol.description: The holder as module+offset, such as game.exe+1A2B30, when a module image holds it.

name: pointer_list_maps
title: List pointer maps
description: Lists the pointer maps with their capture progress, oldest first, without any Cheat Engine call. Poll it after pointer_create_map: a map is usable when state is ready, or stopped or expired with what it read. Check incomplete and unreadableBytes before trusting an absence.

jobId.description: The capture job's id, for runtime_list_jobs and runtime_stop_job.

state.description: Where the capture stands; the map is usable when ready, stopped or expired.

processId.description: The process the map was captured from.

pointerSize.description: The target pointer width in bytes, 4 or 8.

unreadableBytes.description: How many requested bytes could not be read.

incomplete.description: Whether the capture skipped memory or stopped early; absence in the map is then no proof.

progressPercent.description: How much of the planned memory was read, 0 to 100.

error.description: Why the capture failed or ended early.

name: pointer_list_paths
title: List pointer paths
description: Pages the stored paths of a pointer scan without any Cheat Engine call. Offsets are signed hexadecimal in dereference order (Cheat Engine's address list shows them reversed); expression is ready for other tools. Prefer roots in the main module, fewer levels and small offsets.

scanName.description: The scan whose paths are listed.

offset.description: The zero-based first path of the page.

sortBy.description: The order: depth (fewest levels), offset_sum (smallest offsets) or module (by root module).

moduleContains.description: Keep only paths whose root module name contains this text, ignoring case.

total.description: How many paths match the filter.

incomplete.description: Whether the scan may miss paths or keeps unverified ones.

expression.description: The path as a Cheat Engine address expression, such as [["game.exe"+1A2B30]+10]+4C8.

base.description: The root address when the path was found, uppercase hexadecimal.

offsets.description: The offsets in dereference order, signed hexadecimal.

verification.description: How the path was last verified: snapshot_match, live_match or unresolved.

module.description: The root's module, when a module holds the root; rescans rebase it by name.

moduleOffset.description: The root's offset in its module, uppercase hexadecimal, when a module holds the root.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted on the last page.

name: pointer_list_scans
title: List pointer scans
description: Lists the pointer scans with their search progress and counts, oldest first, without any Cheat Engine call. Poll it after pointer_find_paths: the paths are usable when state is ready, or stopped or expired with what was found.

jobId.description: The search job's id, for runtime_list_jobs and runtime_stop_job.

state.description: Where the search stands; the paths are usable when ready, stopped or expired.

incomplete.description: Whether the paths may miss some: an incomplete map, a limit, a stop or unresolved paths.

traversalLimited.description: Whether maxNodes or maxResults stopped the search.

visitedNodes.description: How many candidate pointers were visited.

elapsedMs.description: How long the search ran, in milliseconds.

error.description: Why the search failed or ended early.

name: pointer_read_chain
title: Read a pointer chain
description: Follows a pointer chain hop by hop at the target's pointer width and optionally reads the final value. Offsets are signed hexadecimal in dereference order: base game.exe+1A2B30 with offsets ["10","4C8"] reads [[game.exe+1A2B30]+10]+4C8. An unreadable hop fails with memory_read_failed and details {hopIndex, readAt}.

base.description: The address that holds the first pointer: an address, symbol or expression such as game.exe+1A2B30.

offsets.description: One to 64 signed hexadecimal offsets in dereference order, such as ["10", "-8"].

valueType.description: The type of the final value to read; omit it to follow the chain only.

length.description: For valueType bytes the byte count (required), for string and wstring the maximum length; 1 to 65536.

expression.description: The chain as a Cheat Engine address expression, such as [[game.exe+1A2B30]+10]+4C8.

base.description: The resolved base address, uppercase hexadecimal.

readAt.description: The address the pointer was read from, uppercase hexadecimal.

pointer.description: The pointer value read there, uppercase hexadecimal.

offset.description: The signed hexadecimal offset added to the pointer.

next.description: The pointer plus the offset: the next address read, or the final address.

address.description: The final address, uppercase hexadecimal.

value.description: The value at the final address as text, when valueType was given.

name: pointer_rescan_paths
title: Rescan pointer paths
description: Keeps only the stored paths that still reach target, typically after a restart. With mapName it follows them through that map without scanning; otherwise it reads them live, 256 paths per short dispatch, and a changed process selection stops it with target_changed. Module roots rebase by module name; absolute roots stay absolute. A path that cannot be followed is kept as unresolved unless dropUnresolved is set. Any failure keeps the original paths.

scanName.description: The scan whose paths are filtered.

target.description: The target's current address: hexadecimal, or a symbol resolved in the selected process.

mapName.description: A pointer map to check against instead of live memory.

dropUnresolved.description: Also remove the paths that could not be followed.

verified.description: How many remaining paths reached the target.

removed.description: How many paths were removed: they reach another address, or were unresolved and dropped.

unresolved.description: How many paths could not be followed; they are kept unless dropUnresolved was set.

incomplete.description: Whether the scan may miss paths or keeps unverified ones.

name: release_target_resources
description: Release owned scans, symbols, allocations and patches in reverse creation order before switching processes. Stops at the first incomplete release.

name: reset_memory_scan
description: Reset main through CE's New Scan action (clearing visible results), or release one independent Client session. Refuses to reset a running UI scan; cancel it in CE first.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or the independent scanner name to release.

name: resume_process
description: Resume the currently opened Cheat Engine target process.

name: save_cheat_table
description: Save the current table to a trusted absolute Cheat Engine table path.

filename.description: Absolute destination path under a configured trusted table root.

name: save_opened_file
description: Save the open file-as-process target, optionally to an explicit filename.

filename.description: Optional destination filename, up to 4096 characters.

name: select_memory_record
description: Select one current Cheat Engine address-list record by ID.

name: set_comment
description: Set a persistent user-defined Memory View comment at a target address.

address.description: Target address or symbol expression.

name: set_memory_record_active
description: Activate or deactivate one memory record by Client-issued record ID.

name: set_memory_record_offsets
description: Replace a memory record's pointer offsets. Offsets are Cheat Engine internal order, index zero nearest the final value.

offsets.description: Pointer offsets in Cheat Engine internal order, up to 128 entries.

name: set_memory_record_script
description: Set a bounded Auto Assembler script on a memory record. The record persists it in the cheat table.

script.description: Auto Assembler script text, up to 1 MiB.

name: set_pointer_size
description: Set Cheat Engine's configured target pointer size to 4 or 8 bytes.

size.description: Pointer size in bytes: 4 or 8.

name: set_speedhack_speed
description: Enable Cheat Engine speedhack and set a finite positive target speed.

name: structure_add_elements
title: Add structure elements
description: Adds elements to a structure, all or nothing: when Cheat Engine refuses one, the elements this call added are removed again. Cheat Engine orders elements by offset, so indices returns where each added element landed.

elements.description: The elements to add (1-256); offsets are signed hexadecimal.

offset.description: The offset from the structure's start, as signed hexadecimal such as 4C8 or -8.

name.description: The element's name, up to 256 characters; may be empty.

display.description: How to display an integer element: signed for intN, unsigned or hex for uintN; defaults to the type's signedness.

byteSize.description: The byte size of a string, wstring or bytes element (1-65536); required for them, refused otherwise.

childStructure.description: The name of the structure a pointer element points to; pointer elements only.

childStructureStart.description: Where the pointer lands inside the child structure, as signed hexadecimal; default 0.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

elementCount.description: The number of elements after the change.

indices.description: The indices of the added or updated elements after Cheat Engine reordered them by offset, or the removed indices.

name: structure_autoguess
title: Auto-guess a structure
description: Lets Cheat Engine guess element types from the current bytes at address, like the dissect window's automatic guess, creating the structure when missing. Guesses are unconfirmed: pointers can read as integers and padding as fields. Keep size to the object, usually 1024-4096 bytes.

address.description: The object's base address or symbol expression, such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or [game.exe+1C]+10.

offset.description: The offset inside the structure where guessing starts, as signed hexadecimal.

size.description: The bytes to guess from, a decimal count (1-65536).

createIfMissing.description: Create the structure when no structure has this name.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

name: structure_compare
title: Compare structure instances
description: Compares instances byte for byte, like the dissect window's group compare, to find a field that separates group A (such as the player) from group B (enemies). Rows are cells of granularity bytes over size bytes, or the elements of structureName. Each row is constant, discriminator (constant inside each group, different between them), varies_a, varies_b, varies_both or unreadable; mode picks which rows return. Validate a discriminator with more samples before relying on it.

groupA.description: Group A's base addresses or symbol expressions (1-32).

groupB.description: Group B's base addresses or symbol expressions (0-32); discriminate needs at least one.

size.description: The bytes to compare from each base, a decimal count (1-16384) that is a multiple of granularity; pass this or structureName.

structureName.description: Compare along this structure's elements instead of raw cells; pass this or size.

granularity.description: The cell size in bytes for size mode: 1, 2, 4 or 8.

interpretAs.description: How size-mode cells read: auto, signed, unsigned, float (granularity 4 or 8) or hex.

mode.description: Which rows to return: discriminate, constant, differs (not equal everywhere) or all.

offset.description: The zero-based index of the first selected row to return.

groupA.description: The resolved addresses of group A.

groupB.description: The resolved addresses of group B.

offset.description: The field's offset, as signed hexadecimal.

size.description: The field's size in bytes.

classification.description: What the field shows across the groups.

valuesA.description: The field in each instance of group A, in request order; null when unreadable.

valuesB.description: The field in each instance of group B, in request order; null when unreadable.

name.description: The element's name when comparing along a structure; omitted otherwise.

total.description: The number of rows the mode selects.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted when the listing is complete.

name: structure_create
title: Create a structure
description: Creates a global structure from at most one source: explicit elements, a copy of cloneFrom, or the PDB type pdbTypeName of the loaded symbols; with none it is empty. It is all or nothing and refuses an existing name. The structure persists in Cheat Engine and is saved with the table; delete what you created with structure_delete.

name.description: The new structure's case-sensitive name; it must not exist yet.

elements.description: The elements to create (at most 1024); offsets are signed hexadecimal.

offset.description: The offset from the structure's start, as signed hexadecimal such as 4C8 or -8.

name.description: The element's name, up to 256 characters; may be empty.

display.description: How to display an integer element: signed for intN, unsigned or hex for uintN; defaults to the type's signedness.

byteSize.description: The byte size of a string, wstring or bytes element (1-65536); required for them, refused otherwise.

childStructure.description: The name of the structure a pointer element points to; pointer elements only.

childStructureStart.description: Where the pointer lands inside the child structure, as signed hexadecimal; default 0.

cloneFrom.description: The name of an existing structure to copy.

pdbTypeName.description: The name of a type in the loaded PDB symbols; check it with structure_get_pdb_layout first.

internal.description: Create an internal structure: selectable as a child structure, but hidden from the structure list and not saved with the table.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

name: structure_delete
title: Delete a structure
description: Deletes a structure from Cheat Engine; pointer elements of other structures that pointed to it lose their child structure. Delete only structures you created, unless the user asks. An unknown name is not_found.

name: structure_fill_from_dotnet
title: Fill a structure from .NET
description: Adds the fields of the managed object at address, as Cheat Engine's .NET data collector reports them, to a structure, creating it when missing; give the object's address, not a field's. It refuses with busy while the target is paused or stopped in the debugger, and with not_found when no .NET layout is found. The query runs out of process and can block Cheat Engine for a few seconds.

address.description: The managed object's address or symbol expression.

rename.description: Rename the structure to the object's .NET class name.

createIfMissing.description: Create the structure when no structure has this name.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

name: structure_get
title: Get a structure
description: Reads one structure, internal ones included, and a page of its elements ordered by offset: index, hexadecimal offset, name, valueType, integer display, byteSize and child structure. The detailed format adds the child start, custom type and bit fields.

offset.description: The zero-based index of the first element to return.

format.description: concise, or detailed for the child start, custom type and bit fields.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

internal.description: Whether the structure is internal: selectable as a child but hidden and never saved.

index.description: The element's zero-based index; elements are ordered by offset.

offset.description: The element's offset from the structure's start, as signed hexadecimal.

name.description: The element's name; may be empty.

display.description: How Cheat Engine displays an integer element; omitted for other types.

childStructure.description: The structure a pointer element points to; omitted when none.

childStructureStart.description: Where the pointer lands inside the child structure, as signed hexadecimal; detailed format only.

customType.description: The name of a custom element's custom type; detailed format only.

bitStart.description: The first bit of a binary element; detailed format only.

bitSize.description: The bit count of a binary element; detailed format only.

total.description: The number of elements in the whole structure.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted when the listing is complete.

name: structure_get_pdb_layout
title: Get a PDB structure layout
description: Reads the fields of a type from the loaded PDB symbols: offset, name and value type. found is false when the symbols do not describe it; load a PDB with symbol_add_module(enumStructures=true). Create a structure from it with structure_create(pdbTypeName).

typeName.description: The PDB type name, such as _PEB.

found.description: Whether the loaded symbols describe the type.

elements.description: The type's fields, in Cheat Engine's order.

offset.description: The field's offset, as signed hexadecimal.

valueType.description: The field's value type; omitted when Cheat Engine reports none.

truncated.description: Whether the type has more fields than the limit.

name: structure_list
title: List structures
description: Pages Cheat Engine's global Structure Dissect definitions: name, size and element count. Structures are shared with the user and saved in the cheat table; check a name here before creating one.

nameContains.description: Only structures whose name contains this text, ignoring case; omit for all.

offset.description: The zero-based index of the first structure to return.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

total.description: The number of structures that match the filter.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted when the listing is complete.

truncated.description: Whether a host-side cap stopped the enumeration of global structures.

name: structure_read
title: Read structure values
description: Reads a page of a structure's elements at up to 16 base addresses, like Cheat Engine's dissect window: one column per address and one row per element, values in the contract format of the element's valueType, null where unreadable. fromOffset and toOffset keep only elements in that offset range; one page spans at most 65536 bytes.

addresses.description: The base addresses or symbol expressions (1-16), one column each.

fromOffset.description: Only elements at or after this offset, as signed hexadecimal.

toOffset.description: Only elements at or before this offset, as signed hexadecimal.

offset.description: The zero-based index of the first element of the range to return.

format.description: concise, or detailed to add each element's byteSize, display and raw bytes.

columns.description: One column per base address, in request order.

address.description: The resolved base address.

confirmedLength.description: The bytes Cheat Engine confirmed readable from the lowest element offset of the page; elements past it read as null.

elements.description: One row per element of this page.

offset.description: The element's offset, as signed hexadecimal.

values.description: The value at each column's address, in column order; integers in decimal, pointers in hexadecimal, null when unreadable.

byteSize.description: The bytes the element occupies; detailed format only.

display.description: How Cheat Engine displays an integer element; detailed format only.

raw.description: The element's bytes at each column's address, null when unreadable; detailed format only.

total.description: The number of elements in the offset range.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted when the listing is complete.

name: structure_remove_elements
title: Remove structure elements
description: Removes elements by their current indices, highest first so the others keep their index. Every index is checked first; a refusal stops the batch with partial_effect. indices returns the removed indices.

indices.description: The distinct zero-based indices to remove (1-256), from structure_get.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

elementCount.description: The number of elements after the change.

indices.description: The indices of the added or updated elements after Cheat Engine reordered them by offset, or the removed indices.

name: structure_update_elements
title: Update structure elements
description: Renames, retypes or moves elements. Every update names an element by its index before this call; all are checked first, then applied in order. The first refusal stops the batch with partial_effect (details.applied, details.failedIndex); read the structure with structure_get before retrying the rest.

updates.description: The updates (1-256); each sets at least one field.

index.description: The element's zero-based index before this call, from structure_get.

offset.description: A new offset, as signed hexadecimal; omit to keep it.

name.description: A new name, up to 256 characters; omit to keep it.

valueType.description: A new value type; omit to keep it. String, wstring and bytes also need byteSize.

display.description: A new display for an integer element; omit to keep it or to follow a new valueType.

byteSize.description: A new byte size (1-65536) for a string, wstring or bytes element; omit to keep it.

size.description: The bytes from the structure's start to the end of its last element.

elementCount.description: The number of elements after the change.

indices.description: The indices of the added or updated elements after Cheat Engine reordered them by offset, or the removed indices.

name: structure_write_element
title: Write a structure element
description: Writes value into the target at address plus the element's offset, encoded as the element's valueType (integers in decimal or 0x hexadecimal, pointers in hexadecimal, bytes as 48 8B 05, text with a terminator when it fits), then reads it back. Bit fields and custom types use Cheat Engine's own text format. It is a mutation: after an error, check hostEffect before trying again.

address.description: The structure instance's base address or symbol expression.

index.description: The element's zero-based index, from structure_get.

value.description: The value to write, in the format of the element's valueType.

address.description: The element's address: the base address plus the element's offset.

size.description: The bytes written.

value.description: The value read back after the write; omitted when the read-back failed.

name: symbol_add_module
title: Load symbols from a file
description: Load the symbols of a file, such as a game-shipped PDB or a DLL, as a module at baseAddress (Cheat Engine's symbolHandlerAddModule). enumStructures also enumerates PDB structures for structure_get_pdb_layout. path must be an absolute path on a local fixed drive; UNC, device and linked paths, alternate streams and the MCP directories are refused, and the file stays locked against changes during the load. One native call: a large PDB blocks Cheat Engine for several seconds (blocking_native).

path.description: The absolute path of the symbol file on a local fixed drive, such as C:\Games\Game\game.pdb.

baseAddress.description: The base address the symbols apply to, as an address expression such as game.exe or 7FF6A1B20000.

enumStructures.description: Also enumerate PDB structures, which structure_get_pdb_layout reads; slower.

path.description: The normalized path of the loaded file.

base.description: The base address the symbols were loaded at, as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

enumStructures.description: Whether PDB structures were enumerated for structure_get_pdb_layout.

name: symbol_get_module_preference
title: Get module preference
description: Read Cheat Engine's module precedence for symbol lookup: when a symbol name exists in several modules, the first listed module wins. Names are extensionless; at most 1024 are returned.

modules.description: Extensionless module names; a symbol present in several modules resolves in the first listed one.

truncated.description: Whether Cheat Engine's list is longer than the 1024 names copied.

name: symbol_list_registered
title: List registered symbols
description: Page every symbol registered in Cheat Engine (by tables, Auto Assembler scripts, Lua and this plugin), marking with ownedByMcp the ones this activation registered and can unregister. Allocation symbols carry their size. Filter with nameContains, then page with offset and limit (at most 1000); at most 8192 symbols are copied.

nameContains.description: A case-insensitive substring of the symbol name; at most 256 characters.

offset.description: The index of the first symbol to return.

limit.description: The most symbols to return, 1 to 1000.

total.description: The number of copied symbols that match nameContains.

truncated.description: Whether Cheat Engine holds more than the 8192 symbols that were copied.

symbols.description: The symbols of this page, in Cheat Engine's order.

ownedByMcp.description: Whether this plugin activation registered it (symbol_register); only those can be unregistered.

address.description: The address it names, as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

doNotSave.description: Whether a saved cheat table omits the symbol; omitted when false.

allocSize.description: The size of the allocation it names, for an Auto Assembler alloc; omitted otherwise.

processId.description: The process of that allocation; omitted otherwise.

resourceId.description: The resource id of an owned symbol, as runtime_list_resources reports it.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; omitted on the last page.

name: symbol_register
title: Register a symbol
description: Register a named symbol, such as playerBase, for an address, so later address expressions, records and scripts can use the name. The address expression is resolved once, now. The symbol is owned by this plugin activation: at most 128 at a time; symbol_unregister, runtime_release_resources or disabling the plugin removes it. A name that already resolves in Cheat Engine (another symbol, a module or a hexadecimal number) is refused. doNotSave (default true) keeps it out of saved cheat tables.

name.description: The symbol name, 1 to 256 characters; use a distinctive name such as playerBase.

address.description: The address it names, as an address expression such as [game.exe+1A2B]+10 or 7FF6A1B2C3D0.

doNotSave.description: Keep the symbol out of saved cheat tables.

name.description: The symbol name; use it in any address expression.

address.description: The address it names, as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

doNotSave.description: Whether a saved cheat table omits the symbol.

resourceId.description: The id runtime_list_resources reports for it; runtime_release_resources and symbol_unregister release it.

name: symbol_reload
title: Reload symbols
description: Start a symbol reload and return at once; it never waits. new_modules loads the symbols of modules loaded since the last scan, all reinitializes the whole symbol handler, dotnet reinitializes the .NET symbols (after code was JIT-compiled), optionally of one module. done tells whether Cheat Engine reports every symbol loaded; while it is false, poll runtime_get_overview (symbolsLoaded) instead of waiting.

module.description: The .NET module to reinitialize, such as Assembly-CSharp.dll; only with scope dotnet.

done.description: Whether Cheat Engine reports every symbol loaded; false while loading continues in the background.

scope.description: The reload that was started: new_modules, all or dotnet.

name: symbol_resolve
title: Resolve addresses and names
description: Resolve up to 256 Cheat Engine expressions in one call. Each expression may be an address (7FF6A1B2C3D0), a module offset (game.exe+1A2B), an export (kernel32.CreateFileW), a registered symbol or pointer arithmetic ([game.exe+10]+8). Each entry returns the address, Cheat Engine's best name for it (module+offset or symbol) and the symbol record when the expression names one. An expression that does not resolve carries its own error; check every entry. shallow skips the slower lookups, such as symbols still loading.

expressions.description: 1 to 256 expressions, each 1 to 1024 characters, such as game.exe+1A2B or 7FF6A1B2C3D0.

shallow.description: Use Cheat Engine's shallow resolution, which skips the slower symbol lookups.

items.description: One entry per expression, in request order; check each entry's error.

address.description: The resolved address as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x; omitted when it did not resolve.

name.description: Cheat Engine's best name for the address: a registered symbol, module.export or module+offset.

symbol.description: The symbol record, when the expression names a symbol Cheat Engine knows.

module.description: The module that defines the symbol.

key.description: The symbol's search key, its name without the module.

address.description: The symbol's address as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

size.description: The symbol's size in bytes, zero when unknown.

error.description: Why this expression did not resolve; the other entries are unaffected.

kind.description: The failure class, such as not_found.

name: symbol_set_module_preference
title: Set module preference
description: Change Cheat Engine's module precedence for symbol lookup. By default the given modules move to the front in the given order and the rest of the current list follows; replace=true makes them the whole list, dropping the others. Names are extensionless (game, not game.exe). Returns the list read back. It affects every later lookup in this Cheat Engine, tables included.

modules.description: 1 to 64 extensionless module names, first first, such as ["game", "engine"].

replace.description: Replace the whole list instead of moving these modules to the front.

modules.description: Extensionless module names; a symbol present in several modules resolves in the first listed one.

truncated.description: Whether Cheat Engine's list is longer than the 1024 names copied.

name: symbol_unregister
title: Unregister a symbol
description: Unregister a symbol that this plugin activation registered with symbol_register. A name this activation does not own is not_found, including symbols of tables and scripts. An incomplete release is a partial_effect error whose details carry the release outcome: retryable means nothing happened yet and the call can be repeated; otherwise manual recovery is needed.

name.description: The symbol name, as symbol_register returned it (case-insensitive).

address.description: The address it named, as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

hostEffect.description: How far the Cheat Engine release work got.

isRetryable.description: Whether nothing was done yet, so a later release tries again.

requiresManualRecovery.description: Whether something may remain that only manual recovery can remove.

name: update_memory_record
description: Update one memory record by Client-issued record ID.

id.description: Client-issued memory-record ID from get_address_list or add_memory_record.

address.description: Replacement address expression, if any.

variableType.description: Replacement Cheat Engine variable type, if any.
